name: lexcerta
description: MCP server for legal citation verification via CourtListener

scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test:worker-qualification && npm run test:telemetry && npm run test:admin && npm run test:deployment && npm run test:corpus-fixtures && npm run test:node

scripts.format: biome format --write package.json tsconfig.json test/tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts vitest.admin.config.ts vitest.telemetry.config.ts wrangler.jsonc wrangler.admin.jsonc wrangler.telemetry.jsonc scripts src/admin src/admission src/courtlistener src/cache src/retention src/telemetry src/worker.ts src/worker-request.ts src/request-body.ts src/mcp.ts src/auth src/verification test operations examples src/postgres tsconfig.postgres.json src/node tsconfig.node.json
